Flags accepted by `bun create pleyn <directory>`.

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--no-docker` | do not start Postgres; use DATABASE_URL as it stands |
| `--no-install` | do not run bun install |
| `--no-git` | do not create a git repository |
